x-e-e1-01.title: Find the actions wey no follow the pool notice rules.
x-e-e1-01.topic: Short greetings, notices, and pictures wey words describe
x-e-e1-01.goal: Match the three notice rules with each person's situation, choose the people wey break rules, and explain why in English.
x-e-e1-01.material:
The notice for pool entrance (words only, no picture):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = adult)

Four people wan go pool.
Mina na 7. She come with her mama and get cap.
Jun na 10. E come alone and no get cap.
Tom na 6. E come with e brother. E brother na 9. Tom get cap.
Sue na 11. She waka go pool alone and get cap.
x-e-e1-01.thinking.0: Apply each rule to each person separately.
x-e-e1-01.thinking.2: Tell somebody in English and give evidence.
x-e-e1-01.prereq.1: Simple pronouns like I, you, he, she
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.prompt: Choose everybody wey break the notice rules.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Make table with each person's age, who dem come with, and whether dem get cap, one by one.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Find the information each rule connect to, then join dem with lines.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.a: Check whether you match Mina age and who she come with against rule 3.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.b: Match rule 2 with wetin Jun get.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.c: Think whether the person wey come with Tom be the same kind of person wey the rule talk about.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.d: Compare Sue age and the way she waka with rules 1 and 3, one by one.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.explain: Jun no get cap, so e break rule 2. Tom under 8, but e brother wey come with am na 9, so e no be 'grown-up', and Tom break rule 3. Mina come with her mama, and Sue na 11, so e okay for her to waka and come alone.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.prompt: Write one or two English sentences to Tom brother. Connect the reason Tom no fit enter the pool now with the rule.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.hint.0: First compare Tom age with the number for rule 3.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Start with 'Tom is under 8, so ...' and write wetin suppose follow.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: You connect why Tom no fit enter with the rule (under 8)?
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: You explain why e brother no be grown-up?
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Your English sentences short and easy to understand?

x-e-e1-02.topic: Short greetings, notices, and pictures wey words describe

x-e-e1-02.goal: Compare the lost-and-found notice with the message wey friend copy am line by line, find the wrong line, and correct am.
x-e-e1-02.material:
Notice for school board (words only):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Your friend Jia see the notice because she dey find her water bottle, and send message to Hana. Hana wan compare am with the notice.

x-e-e1-02.thinking.1: Correct information wey dem mix up
x-e-e1-02.thinking.2: Write the sentence wey you correct in English
x-e-e1-02.prereq.1: How to read room numbers like Room 1, Room 3
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.prompt: Choose one line for Jia message wey different from the notice.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Point to the words in the notice (colour, room number, person's name) one by one and match dem with the message lines.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Match each message line with the notice line wey e copy, then look for any word wey no match.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.explain: Line 4 wrong. The notice say Ms. Park dey Room 1, but the message say Room 3, so e wrong. Blue for line 2 match the notice, and Room 3 for line 3 na where dem find the bottle, so e correct.

x-e-e1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: You separate where dem find the bottle (Room 3) from where to ask (Room 1)?

x-e-e1-10.title: Finish 'I go late' message so Mom no worry

x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: If you see only this one line, who fit be the speaker?

x-e-e1-05.topic: Clues about who, wetin, and where
x-e-e1-05.title: Cinema or train station? Compare how strong clues be
x-e-e1-05.goal: Compare how strongly clues in conversation show the place, and explain in English why weak clues alone no enough.
x-e-e1-05.material:
Two people talk like this.
A: Two tickets, please.
B: Which film?
A: The 3 o'clock one.
B: Row F or Row G?
A: Row F, please.

(Row = one line of seats, film = movie)

Your friend Yuna talk, "Tickets! Na train station." Your friend Min talk, "Na cinema (movie theater)."
x-e-e1-05.thinking.1: Know one clue fit match different places
x-e-e1-05.thinking.2: Answer your friend claim with evidence
x-e-e1-05.prereq.0: Easy words, for example ticket, film, and seat
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.prompt: Choose all the clues wey support Min statement ('cinema') strongest.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Test each clue by asking 'Could people use this for other places too?'
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Imagine saying the same words for train station or zoo.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.a: Think whether cinema na the only place wey people need ticket.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.b: Think which place film belong to.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.c: Think whether time only come up for cinema.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.d: Think wetin the row and letter show.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.explain: Film (movie) and Row F/G (line of seats) strong clues say na cinema. Ticket and 3 o'clock weak, because train station, zoo, or concert hall fit use dem too.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.prompt: Answer Yuna in one or two English sentences. Explain why 'tickets' alone no fit show say na train station.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Think of two or three other places wey people use 'ticket'.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Try start like this: 'Tickets can be for ... too.'
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: You name at least one other place wey people use ticket?
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: You mention clues wey point to cinema (film, Row)?

x-e-e1-06.material:
One friend dey think about an object. Two clues:

Hint 2: E dey kitchen.

x-e-e1-06.s.s1.hint.1: Write the choices wey go remain if the answer na 'yes' and if na 'no'.
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.r.a: Check whether any of the four choices go get different answer.
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.r.b: Check whether Hint 1 don teach you this already.
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.r.c: Check whether Hint 2 don teach you this already.
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.r.d: Think whether the answer go split the 4 choices.
